pages.text: Tame an animal by feeding it until hearts appear. Foxes, rabbits, frogs and axolotls can be tamed here too!$(br2)A $(l)name tag$() keeps any animal from despawning.
Rename a $(l)Collar Tag$() at an anvil, add pet enchantments there too, then right-click your tamed pet. Pet beds let pets respawn.
